# Bundled wallpapers

These JPEGs ship inside the image and are served same-origin at
`/assets/wallpapers/<file>` with a year-long immutable cache (rule three:
nothing is fetched from a third party at runtime). A canvas background of the
kind `{ "type": "wallpaper", "id": … }` names one by its catalogue id in
`apps/server/src/wallpapers.ts`; the manifest carries the file names the
server resolved, and the wall picks the smaller or the larger one by its own
pixel size.

**Generated by `scripts/wallpapers/generate.mjs`, and licensed under this
project's own licence (AGPL-3.0-or-later; see `NOTICE`).** Every wallpaper is
a parametric SVG drawn from a seed by that script and rasterised by the
bundled headless Chromium, so there is no stock-photo licence question —
stock licences often forbid redistribution in a bundle — and a wallpaper is
regenerated or changed by editing its drawing or its seed. The catalogue the
server reads, `apps/server/src/wallpaper-catalogue.ts`, is written by the same
script, with each picture's mean colour and luminance measured off the raster.

The set is the twenty-six of plan item P6.2 (Q10): soft gradients, paper and
textures, contour lines, geometric shapes, landscapes, the four seasons, and
two for fun. Fourteen are dark and twelve light; every one is held, from the
bytes it ships as, to 4.5:1 for the text of every built-in theme of its tone
through the Soft widget ground (`browser-wallpaper-contrast.test.ts`), and a
wallpaper that fails that does not ship.

The file names are content-hashed (`<id>-<long edge>.<hash>.jpg`), so an
edited picture is a new URL and a year of caching on a wall stays honest.
`wallpapers.test.ts` holds every name in the catalogue to the bytes on disk,
and the directory's total size to a 40 MB budget, photographs included (MD6
set 25 MB for the first sixteen; the owner raised it for the twelve after).

**Not every picture here is generated.** The photographs and paintings in the
section below (plan item M4.5) are other people's public-domain work, fetched
from a source on the plan's allowlist by `scripts/wallpapers/photos.mjs`,
which records where each came from and writes this section and `NOTICE`'s
from that record. `wallpaper-photos.test.ts` fails on a picture with no
credit, or on a licence or a host off the allowlist.

## Photographs and paintings

GENERATED by `scripts/wallpapers/photos.mjs` from the list in that script; do
not edit between these markers.

These are not this project's work and are not under its licence. Each is a
picture from a source on the plan's allowlist (MD5), public domain or under
Creative Commons Attribution, resized and re-encoded and otherwise unchanged.
A picture under CC BY carries its required credit, which the wallpaper picker
shows beside it. The licences:

- **Public domain, National Gallery of Art open access** — Images of public-domain works, free of charge for any use, whether commercial or non-commercial. https://www.nga.gov/artworks/free-images-and-open-access
- **Public domain, NASA** — NASA content is generally not subject to copyright in the United States; credit NASA. https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/
- **Public domain, Rijksmuseum** — Images of works in the public domain, marked with the Public Domain Mark or CC0, free to use for any purpose. https://data.rijksmuseum.nl/policy
- **CC BY 4.0, ESA/Hubble** — Released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence; the credit listed with each image must be shown with it. https://esahubble.org/copyright/
- **CC BY 4.0, ESA/Webb** — Released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence; the credit listed with each image must be shown with it. https://esawebb.org/copyright/
